name: homestead-control
description: 6-building homestead monitoring and control for OneMind OS

tools.name: homestead_status
tools.description: Get aggregated status for one or all 6 homestead buildings. Queries node heartbeats + WireClaw sensor data in parallel.

building.description: Specific building node ID. Omit to query all 6.

include_sensors.description: Include WireClaw sensor data (temp, humidity, soil, motion, etc.)

tools.name: homestead_alert
tools.description: Publish a homestead alert to NATS for logging, notification, and multi-agent routing

building.description: Building node ID where the alert originated

route_to.description: Agent to route alert to (legacy handles directly, le for maintenance, hp for wellness, ge for economics)

data.description: Additional structured data for the alert

author: Zeus Delacruz / OneMind OS
